cases.name: Service metadata
cases.notes: Returns service metadata and layer list. Capabilities string is dynamic.

cases.name: Append (service)
cases.notes: Delegates to applyEdits semantics and returns append counts.

cases.name: Apply Edits (service)
cases.notes: Batch edits across layers using a JSON array of per-layer edit payloads.

cases.name: Create Replica
cases.notes: Registers offline replica state in distributed cache when available, otherwise in memory.

cases.name: Extract Changes
cases.notes: First sync returns full adds; later syncs do not provide database-grade incremental change tracking.

cases.name: Query (service)
cases.notes: Delegates to a target layer selected by layerId or layers.

cases.name: Query Contingent Values
cases.notes: Serves per-layer contingent value definitions from the canonical Metadata v2 graph (contingentValueGroups). Layers with none, and services with none, return an empty contingentValuesDefinitions collection. The same definition is surfaced on layer metadata as contingentValuesDefinition. Automated import of contingent values from Esri sources is deferred.

cases.name: Query Domains
cases.notes: Returns coded-value domains discovered from the backing data.

cases.name: Relationships
cases.notes: Aggregates relationship metadata across service layers.

cases.name: List Replicas; replica info
cases.notes: Lists registered replica metadata for the service and returns a single replica descriptor by id. Backed by the same replica store as createReplica/synchronizeReplica.

cases.name: Synchronize Replica
cases.notes: Supports download, upload, and bidirectional sync directions.

cases.name: validateSQL (service)
cases.notes: Esri's canonical service-root validateSQL: takes sql + sqlType (where|orderBy|expression) and validates against a representative service layer through the shared ArcGIS SQL parser. The layer-level route is classified separately.

cases.name: Layer metadata
cases.notes: Includes editing info, templates, statistics flags, and relationships where available.

cases.name: Calculate
cases.notes: Supports calcExpression arrays of field/sqlExpression pairs.

cases.name: Delete Features
cases.notes: Supports deletes by objectIds, where, or spatial filter.

cases.name: Generate Renderer
cases.notes: Supports simple renderer output plus classificationDef-driven class-break and unique-value renderers.

cases.name: Query (layer)
cases.notes: Supports filters, statistics, paging, multiple output formats, spatial predicates, and temporal filters.

cases.name: Query Attachments
cases.notes: Supports objectIds plus attachmentTypes, keywords, size, definitionExpression, returnMetadata, and returnUrl facets; globalIds are rejected with a GeoServices 400 because Honua uses integer object IDs.

cases.name: Query Date Bins
cases.notes: Bins features into time intervals on a Date/DateTime field. bin accepts calendarBin (unit: year, quarter, month, week, day, hour, minute, second; mapped to Postgres date_trunc) or fixedBin (intervalCount + intervalUnit: seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks; days default if unrecognized; optional origin in Unix ms). outStatistics is optional and defaults to count. Requires the active temporal.histogram entitlement per the temporal animation contract (ADR-0024); the gate fires after successful service/layer access and before bin parameter parsing on both GET and POST, so requests without the entitlement return HTTP 402 Payment Required with a remediation message regardless of how the bin payload is supplied. See docs/gis/temporal-animation-api.md.

cases.name: Add Attachment
cases.notes: Multipart form-data upload against one feature. The operation is per-feature: the route carries {featureId}.

cases.name: Query Attachment Infos
cases.notes: Returns one feature's attachmentInfos collection.

cases.name: HTML Popup
cases.notes: Route exists and returns the spec-shaped document; no author-defined pop-up store exists, so the content is empty.

cases.name: Image
cases.notes: Route exists and returns the spec-shaped document; no service-level feature-image store exists.

cases.name: Shared Templates and child operations
cases.notes: Routes exist and return the spec-shaped document. Honua has no standalone shared-template store: reads return an empty templates collection and mutations return HTTP 400 rather than fabricating success.

cases.name: Cleanup Assets
cases.notes: Route exists; no layer asset store, so the mutation returns HTTP 400 rather than reporting a fabricated cleanup.

cases.name: Convert 3D
cases.notes: Route exists; no 3D conversion pipeline, so the conversion returns HTTP 400.

cases.name: Has Assets
cases.notes: Route exists; no layer asset store, so it reports false.

cases.name: Update Metadata
cases.notes: Route exists; the Esri metadata-document mutation surface is not backed by the canonical Metadata v2 graph, so it returns HTTP 400. Layer metadata is authored through the Honua admin API.

cases.name: Query 3D
cases.notes: Route exists; no 3D pipeline, so it returns an empty result.

cases.name: Query Assets
cases.notes: Route exists; no layer asset store, so it returns an empty result.

cases.name: Upload Assets
cases.notes: Route exists; no layer asset store, so the mutation returns HTTP 400.

cases.name: where
cases.notes: ArcGIS SQL parser. Operators: =, <>, >, >=, <, <=, AND/OR/NOT, IS [NOT] NULL, [NOT] LIKE, [NOT] IN, [NOT] BETWEEN, arithmetic (+, -, *, /, %). Functions: string (UPPER, LOWER, LENGTH, CHAR_LENGTH, TRIM/LTRIM/RTRIM, SUBSTRING comma-form and SQL-standard SUBSTRING(x FROM s [FOR n]), SUBSTR, REPLACE, CONCAT, POSITION(sub IN str)), math (ABS, CEIL/CEILING, FLOOR, ROUND, POWER, MOD, SQRT, trig), date/time (CURRENT_DATE/TIMESTAMP/TIME, NOW, YEAR/MONTH/DAY/HOUR/MINUTE/SECOND and the SQL-standard EXTRACT(field FROM source) for those fields), type conversion CAST(value AS type) over an allowlisted type set, and #date#/DATE '...'/TIMESTAMP '...' literals. All values are parameterized; no client SQL is interpolated. Re-deferred: CASE WHEN/THEN/ELSE/END expressions, LIKE ... ESCAPE custom escape chars, EXTRACT fields outside YEAR..SECOND (WEEK/QUARTER/DOW/EPOCH), and subqueries (no AST nodes in the shared filter pipeline).

cases.name: inSR, outSR
cases.notes: GeoJSON and GeoParquet enforce EPSG:4326-compatible output behavior.

cases.name: returnGeometry, returnIdsOnly, returnCountOnly, returnExtentOnly, returnZ, returnM
cases.notes: Dimensional behavior varies by output format.

cases.name: nearestCount, returnDistance
cases.notes: returnDistance only affects KNN queries and runtime-computed attributes are format-dependent.

cases.name: f=json, geojson, pbf, fgb, geobuf, parquet, arrow
returnCentroid
cases.notes: GeoServices JSON responses emit polygon centroids and polygon layer metadata advertises supportsReturningGeometryCentroid.

cases.name: returnTrueCurves
cases.notes: Input densified: curvePaths/curveRings (circular-arc and cubic-Bezier segments) supplied on applyEdits or query spatial filters are densified to linear vertices before storage (#1877 Part A); elliptic-arc segments are rejected. Output stays linear: NTS/WKB cannot represent a true curve so returnTrueCurves=true returns the densified linear geometry; Honua advertises supportsTrueCurve=false. Lossless curve storage/re-emission deferred (Refs #1877 Part B).

cases.name: returnExceededLimitFeatures
cases.notes: Accept-and-ignore for interop (#1460): the ArcGIS Maps SDK for .NET always sends it. Honua already returns the truncated page plus exceededTransferLimit=true, so both the default and an explicit false return the same page and flag.

cases.name: resultType
cases.notes: Accepts standard and tile for GeoServices parity and browser-client compatibility; other values are rejected and current behavior matches the standard query path.

cases.name: quantizationParameters
cases.notes: Honored for f=json: the featureSet emits a transform (originPosition/scale/translate, upperLeft or lowerLeft) and geometry coordinates become integer grid deltas; supportsCoordinatesQuantization is advertised true. Ignored for f=geojson; f=pbf returns its own quantized transform.

cases.name: f
cases.notes: Only JSON output is produced; a non-JSON value is rejected.

cases.name: Temporal Extent (Honua extension)
cases.notes: Returns the resolved start/end time field names plus the layer's deterministic min/max timestamps as ISO 8601 UTC and Unix epoch milliseconds. Companion to the GeoServices REST timeInfo block on layer metadata. Returns 404 when the layer is not configured as time-aware (no timeInfo); returns 200 with null min/max when the layer is time-aware but has no rows. Output cached under the LayerMetadata tag and shares its invalidation. JSON only (f=json|pjson); other formats return 400. Community-tier (ADR-0024); see docs/gis/temporal-animation-api.md.

cases.name: Query Clusters (Honua extension)
cases.notes: DBSCAN or K-Means clustering. algorithm defaults to 'dbscan' when omitted. eps is meters (capped by Limits.Analytics.MaxDbscanEpsMeters); algorithm-specific required parameters are validated. returnHullPerCluster=true returns one feature per cluster (capped by Limits.Analytics.MaxClusters) with clusterId and featureCount; default returns one row per source feature with objectId, nested attributes, geometry, and clusterId. outStatistics requires returnHullPerCluster=true; per-feature cluster assignments cannot carry aggregate columns and return HTTP 400 if both are supplied. Shared filters include where, objectIds, geometry/geometryType/inSR/spatialRel, and time/timeRelation; distance-based esri spatial relationships are rejected because distance is operation-specific on the analytics slice. Returns application/geo+json with WGS84 coordinates, numberReturned = features.length, and metadata.operation/inputTruncated/resultTruncated/maxInputFeatures/maxOutputRows (null in per-feature mode, populated in hull mode). FeatureServer-style f is accepted for parity but does not change the response media type; unsupported POST content types return HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type. Bounded by Limits.Analytics.MaxInputFeatures. Requires the active analytics.clustering entitlement (ADR-0024); requests without it return HTTP 402 Payment Required with the GeoServices error envelope and an entitlement remediation message. Deployments without a PostGIS-backed analytics reader (for example the DuckDB read-only provider) return HTTP 501 Not Implemented via TryGetAnalyticsReader.

cases.name: Spatial Join (Honua extension)
cases.notes: Joins target layer against joinLayerId (must differ) using predicate intersects/contains/within/dwithin. dwithin requires positive distance in meters (capped by Limits.Analytics.MaxDWithinDistanceMeters). Each target feature preserves objectId, nested attributes, and geometry while adding matchCount; carryFields is a comma-separated list and is emitted as arrays of matched join-layer values, while outStatistics aggregates over matched rows. The join layer is resolved through the same IResourceValidator access policy as the target. Shared filters include where, objectIds, geometry/geometryType/inSR/spatialRel, and time/timeRelation; distance-based esri spatial relationships are rejected because distance is operation-specific on the analytics slice. Returns application/geo+json with WGS84 coordinates, numberReturned = features.length, and metadata.operation/inputTruncated/resultTruncated/maxInputFeatures/maxOutputRows (null for this operation's maxOutputRows). FeatureServer-style f is accepted for parity but does not change the response media type; unsupported POST content types return HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type. Requires the active analytics.spatial-join entitlement (ADR-0024); requests without it return HTTP 402 Payment Required. Deployments without a PostGIS-backed analytics reader (for example the DuckDB read-only provider) return HTTP 501 Not Implemented via TryGetAnalyticsReader.

cases.name: Query Buffer Aggregate (Honua extension)
cases.notes: Buffers each feature by distance in unit (meters/kilometers/feet/miles). The Limits.Analytics.MaxBufferDistanceMeters cap is enforced after unit conversion so it cannot be bypassed by switching to a larger unit. dissolve=true (default) unions overlapping buffers per group via ST_Union and returns dissolved polygons with featureCount plus any group/stat columns; dissolve=false returns one row per input feature with buffered geometry and objectId. groupByFields and outStatistics follow the standard GeoServices statistics shape. outStatistics requires dissolve=true; per-feature output (dissolve=false) cannot carry aggregate columns and returns HTTP 400. Shared filters include where, objectIds, geometry/geometryType/inSR/spatialRel, and time/timeRelation; distance-based esri spatial relationships are rejected because distance is operation-specific on the analytics slice. Returns application/geo+json with WGS84 coordinates, numberReturned = features.length, and metadata.operation/inputTruncated/resultTruncated/maxInputFeatures/maxOutputRows (null for this operation's maxOutputRows). FeatureServer-style f is accepted for parity but does not change the response media type; unsupported POST content types return HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type. Requires the active analytics.buffer-aggregate entitlement (ADR-0024); requests without it return HTTP 402 Payment Required. Deployments without a PostGIS-backed analytics reader (for example the DuckDB read-only provider) return HTTP 501 Not Implemented via TryGetAnalyticsReader.

cases.name: Query Density (Honua extension)
cases.notes: Hex or square grid binning over Web Mercator. cellSize is meters and is clamped to [Limits.Analytics.MinDensityCellSizeMeters, Limits.Analytics.MaxDensityCellSizeMeters]. Output rows include cellId and featureCount; optional weightField adds a weighted sum column named weight. Shared filters include where, objectIds, geometry/geometryType/inSR/spatialRel, and time/timeRelation; distance-based esri spatial relationships are rejected because distance is operation-specific on the analytics slice. Returns application/geo+json with WGS84 coordinates, numberReturned = features.length, and metadata.operation/inputTruncated/resultTruncated/maxInputFeatures/maxOutputRows. FeatureServer-style f is accepted for parity but does not change the response media type; unsupported POST content types return HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type. Output bounded by Limits.Analytics.MaxDensityCells. Requires the active analytics.density entitlement (ADR-0024); requests without it return HTTP 402 Payment Required. Deployments without a PostGIS-backed analytics reader (for example the DuckDB read-only provider) return HTTP 501 Not Implemented via TryGetAnalyticsReader.

cases.name: Query H3 (Honua extension)
cases.notes: Aggregates features into H3 hexagonal grid cells at a configurable resolution and returns per-cell aggregate statistics. No Esri equivalent.
